item.title: 1Password plans are getting more expensive next month

item.title: Apple iPhone, iPad now approved to handle NATO info
item.description: Apple’s iPhone and iPad now comply with NATO’s information assurance requirements, becoming the first consumer devices with this approval. That means iPhones running iOS 26 and iPads running iPadOS 26 can be used with classified information up to the NATO restricted level.
